subject.IW2591:
說明：請依下面所提供的文字提示寫一篇英文作文，長度約120字（8至12個句子）。評分重點包括內容、組織、文法、用字遣詞、標點符號、大小寫。 
提示：根據我國政府統計，青少年最喜愛的休閒活動是玩線上遊戲或手機遊戲，每天花1到4小時打遊戲。請寫一篇文章 
第一段說明玩電玩的優點和缺點（至少各一項）； 
第二段分享你自己或親友玩電玩的經驗。
subject.HW2541A:
Write an essay of 150-180 words in an appropriate style on the following topic. Write your answer on the Writing Test Answer Sheet.

Many museums, galleries, and scenic spots now use "virtual tourism" in their marketing campaigns. With this technological advancement, people can enjoy exhibitions or scenery from their homes. Write an essay in which you
(1) explain the reasons why virtual tourism is becoming more popular, and
(2) discuss how this trend may affect tourism.
subject.HW2641A:
Write an essay of 150-180 words in an appropriate style on the following topic. Write your answer on the Writing Test Answer Sheet.

Recently, scientists have been developing "care robots" that assist the elderly with daily tasks. Write an essay in which you
(1) provide at least two reasons why care robots are needed, and
(2) discuss the potential problems arising from using such robots to care for the elderly.
